tagline: Fuji取景器相机，1984 年发布
description: Fuji于1984年推出的取景器相机。配备Fujinon 38mm, f/2.8 (Tessar type, 4 elements/3 groups).。快门速度1/8 to 1/500.。使用Auto advance and rewind with mid roll rewind.。感光度100 to 1600 ISO in half stops.。Scale focus with zone projections in the viewfinder, 1 m to infinity.。

specs.对焦: Scale focus with zone projections in the viewfinder, 1 m to infinity.
specs.胶片/画幅: Auto advance and rewind with mid roll rewind.
specs.英文简介: Fuji presented the HD-M (Heavy Duty Motor) in 1984.
